review.tagline: Gradio RAG UI with hybrid retrieval, citations and multi-user login
review.summary: Kotaemon is a Gradio web app for question answering over uploaded documents, with hybrid full-text plus vector retrieval, reranking, citations shown in an in-browser PDF viewer and ReAct or ReWOO agents. It supports OpenAI, Azure, Cohere, Groq, Ollama and GGUF via llama-cpp-python, with Elasticsearch, LanceDB, ChromaDB, Milvus or Qdrant storage. Docker images come in lite, full and ollama variants on port 7860.
review.audience: small teams wanting document Q&A with a ready UI
strengths: Hybrid retriever plus reranking by default, with low-relevance warnings
Citations open in a PDF viewer with highlights and relevance scores
Multi-user login with private and public collections
GraphRAG options: nano-graphrag, LightRAG or Microsoft GraphRAG
weaknesses: GraphRAG extras cause hnswlib version conflicts that need manual pip fixes
Only PDF, HTML, MHTML and XLSX without the larger full image
Last commit 2026-05-30; MS GraphRAG indexing works only with OpenAI or Ollama
needs: Needs Elasticsearch, LanceDB, ChromaDB, Milvus or Qdrant (optional stores), Unstructured (optional, for .doc/.docx and more)
Models: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Cohere, Groq, Ollama
